existing_group_assignments.rationale: Cirrhosis is an advanced stage of liver fibrosis (organ-level pathological outcome), closely related to liver fibrosis and collagen accumulation events already in this group.

Increase in de novo lipogenesis is the same broad process as increased de novo fatty acid synthesis (ID 458), and both are distinct from FAS up-regulation (ID 463), fitting the same_object_different_process group.

new_groups.rationale: All three describe changes in hepatic or ileal bile acid metabolism regulators (FGF15/19, CYP7A1, BSEP/ABCB11) that collectively govern bile acid synthesis and transport, but they involve distinct molecules and biological compartments (ileum vs. liver, synthesis vs. export).
